thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-gateway error-rate-spike (5xx) — urgency=high — triggered at 5m window > 12%

pagerduty-bot: pd/INC123456 triggered by monitor: inference-gateway.ack_required=true. paging on-call.

maria: ack'd. I'm on it — taking primary. pinging infra and runtime.

devon: on my way. seeing a 5xx spike concentrated in eu-west region, inbound qps normal but success_rate down.

sam: looking at the gateway logs now — lots of upstream 503 from model-backend-v2 and intermittent connection resets. Not seeing pod restarts.

jordan: support FYI, initial impact estimate: ~1200 requests/min affected across public API keys; a handful of customers reporting increased errors. low churn so far but could affect SLAs if sustained.

maria: quick mitigation plan: 1) route traffic away from canary model-backend-v2 2) warm fallback pool (model-backend-v1-quant) 3) increase gateway concurrency limits for EU slice 4) enable additional retries with jitter for internal router temporarily.

devon: agree. I'm going to set routing weight to fallback and pin new requests to v1. Doing a canary drain now.

sam: running the drain command:
```
# set weight to 0 for canary
redwoodctl route update inference-gateway --model model-backend-v2 --weight 0 --region eu-west1
# bump fallback pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-backend-v1-quant --replicas=6 --context=prod-eu
```

maria: doing rate-limit relaxation for internal proxy to reduce 429s cascading into upstream errors: changing limit from 200r/s -> 500r/s for eu slice.

pagerduty-bot: escalation timer set: 5m -> next escalation to dev-lead if no progress.

sam: logs show frequent "upstream connection reset by peer" from a subset of IPs hitting a single host in the model pool. Possible network flapping or overloaded instance. I'm isolating that node from the pool.

devon: removed node ip-10-4-12-53 from LB. Confirming drop in error rate on that host.

maria: error rate overall dropping from 12% -> 4% over last 2m after weight change and node isolation. Customer errors trending down.

support: started an ops ticket to inform affected customers: draft message ready, will wait for steady <5% before sending.

jordan: can we get a quick post-checklist? need to know if this was cause by deployment, autoscale, or infra.

sam: deployment history: no new deploys to model-backend-v2 in last 3 hours. Autoscaler metrics show a spike in CPU on that host but other replicas fine — hinting at noisy neighbor / host-level network issue.

maria: notes for incident timeline:
- detect: pd alert at t0 (thread root)
- ack: maria (oncall) t0+30s
- mitigation: traffic re-route to v1 t0+2m
- isolate host ip-10-4-12-53 t0+4m
- error rate back to <5% t0+6m

devon: I'll follow up with infra to run a host health check + NIC diagnostics and check for hypervisor-level events. assigning to infra on-call.

sam: putting a short-term watch: set alert window to 2m and notify channel if >3% again.

incident-bot: creating incident ticket INC-2026-456 in incidents system, linking to PD alert.

maria: handoff plan: I'm handing primary to devon for next 30m while I update timeline and customer note. devon, take it.

devon: taking primary. I'll own the postmortem and follow up with infra & runtime. maria, thanks — plz add the runbook commands you ran into the ticket.

support: sending customer outbound now (prelim): "We're aware of increased 5xx errors impacting some EU customers. We've mitigated the immediate issue by routing traffic to a healthy model variant and isolating an unhealthy host. We're monitoring and will update within 60 minutes." :email:

jordan: nice quick coordination. action items from here:
- infra: host-level diagnostics and root cause (devon)
- runtime: add canary fencing to auto-rollback on upstream connection resets (sam)
- ops: review LB health-check sensitivity (maria)
- support: customer comms + follow-ups (support)

maria: logging our temporary config changes for rollback:
```
# rollback weights after safe window
redwoodctl route update inference-gateway --model model-backend-v2 --weight 50 --region eu-west1
# reset proxy rate limits
redwoodctl config set gateway.proxy.eu.rate_limit 200
```

devon: marking this thread as handed off. I'll set a 1-hour post-incident review and assign notes. If anyone sees error rate creep back up ping me directly @devon.

pagerduty-bot: pd/INC123456 acknowledged by devon. escalation paused.

incident-bot: note: no active deploys during incident window; suspected infra host-level network fault. Incident severity: sev2.

sam: leaving a small snippet of the failing log sample for the postmortem:
```
[2026-03-15T10:17:23Z] ERROR upstream_conn_reset: host=10.4.12.53 req_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate status=503 err="connection reset by peer"
```

support: customer update sent. will log replies here.

maria: thanks everyone — great quick response. closing my ack and moving to standby. :thumbsup:

devon: closing the handoff; will kick off RCA doc and link runbook updates.

incident-bot: thread closed for active mitigation. further updates will be appended to incident INC-2026-456.
